changelog:
v2.5.1 — CALL HARMONY PATCH:

🎧 FIXED: the Call Recorder used to force the speaker ON while recording. With earpods/headset connected, that fights the call's audio routing on Samsung phones — calls could fail to connect until you unplugged the headset. The recorder now NEVER touches your audio path when a headset is connected (records near side only) and always restores your original speaker setting when a recording ends.

📵 The recorder can no longer auto-restart after being killed (no more mic held hostage in the background).

🔐 Removed an unused device-admin capability (limit-password) so the app cannot interact with PIN/password systems on Knox-managed phones. The Guardian only watches failed unlock attempts — nothing else.

⚠️ If call problems persist after this update + a phone restart, they are carrier-side (MTN) or the known Knox Error 206 issue on your phone — NOT the app. Updates in place over v2.5.0.
